const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" -e '
local files = {"mod-tome.lua", "tome-ashes-urhrok.lua", "tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua"}
local function load_records(path)
  local records, current_section = {}, nil
  section = function(s) current_section = s end
  t = function(source, target, source_tag)
    records[#records + 1] = {source=source, target=target, source_tag=source_tag, section=current_section}
  end
  local chunk, err = loadfile(path)
  assert(chunk, err)
  chunk()
  return records
end
local function decode_json_string(s)
  return (s:gsub("\\(.)", function(c)
    local map = {n="\n", t="\t", r="\r", b="\b", f="\f", ["\\"]="\\", ["\""]="\"", ["/"]="/"}
    assert(map[c], "unsupported JSON escape: " .. tostring(c))
    return map[c]
  end))
end
local jf = assert(io.open(".ai/task/repair-w65-20261004/NEW-TARGETS.json", "rb"))
local json = jf:read("*a")
jf:close()
local expected, expected_count = {}, 0
local pat = "\"([0-9a-f]+)\"%s*:%s*{%s*\"file\"%s*:%s*\"(.-)\"%s*,%s*\"section\"%s*:%s*\"(.-)\"%s*,%s*\"source_tag\"%s*:%s*\"(.-)\"%s*,%s*\"old_target\"%s*:%s*\"(.-)\"%s*,%s*\"new_target\"%s*:%s*\"(.-)\"%s*}"
for rev, file, sec, tag, old, new in json:gmatch(pat) do
  expected_count = expected_count + 1
  expected[rev] = {file=file, section=decode_json_string(sec), source_tag=decode_json_string(tag), old_target=decode_json_string(old), new_target=decode_json_string(new), seen=false}
end
assert(expected_count == 11, "expected 11 NEW-TARGETS entries, parsed " .. expected_count)
local changed = 0
for _, file in ipairs(files) do
  local base = load_records(".ai/task/repair-w65-20261004/baseline/" .. file)
  local cur = load_records(file)
  assert(#base == #cur, file .. ": record count changed")
  for i = 1, #base do
    local b, c = base[i], cur[i]
    assert(b.source == c.source, file .. ": source changed at record " .. i)
    assert(b.source_tag == c.source_tag, file .. ": source_tag changed at record " .. i)
    assert(b.section == c.section, file .. ": section changed at record " .. i)
    if b.target ~= c.target then
      changed = changed + 1
      local found_rev = nil
      for rev, e in pairs(expected) do
        if e.file == file and e.section == b.section and e.source_tag == b.source_tag and e.old_target == b.target then
          assert(not found_rev, file .. ": ambiguous expected revision at record " .. i)
          found_rev = rev
        end
      end
      assert(found_rev, file .. ": unexpected target change at record " .. i)
      local e = expected[found_rev]
      assert(c.target == e.new_target, found_rev .. ": current target differs from new_target")
      assert(not e.seen, found_rev .. ": duplicate changed record")
      e.seen = true
      io.write("OK revision ", found_rev, " file=", file, " record=", i, "\n")
    end
  end
end
assert(changed == 11, "changed target count is " .. changed .. ", expected 11")
for rev, e in pairs(expected) do assert(e.seen, rev .. ": expected target change not found") end
io.write("OK LuaJIT loaded 4 current + 4 baseline files; exactly 11 target-only changes match NEW-TARGETS.json\n")
'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":10000}); text(r.output);
